verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vanta handles policies: its AI agent drafts them, the API lists and uploads policies, documents can be submitted for review, and ISO 27001 offers AI-powered templates for roles, responsibilities, and risks. It never shows a lawyer-grade policy template library, a policy editor, versioning, formal approval workflows, or per-employee acceptance tracking. Missing for 10: lawyer-grade policy template library, in-app policy editor, version history, approval workflow, per-employee policy acceptance tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
